questions: Did this episode occur while you were asleep?
Do you have no memory of what happened afterward?
Have similar episodes happened repeatedly?
Have you ever injured yourself or someone else during one of these episodes?
Do you snore loudly or stop breathing during sleep?
Do you act out vivid dreams, with shouting, punching, or kicking?
Have you ever had tongue biting, urinary incontinence, or prolonged confusion after an episode?
During these episodes, do you get out of bed or perform activities without being fully awake?
Do the episodes usually occur during the first half of the night?
Do you have little or no recall of the episode the next morning?
Do the episodes involve sexual touching or sexual activity?
Do the episodes involve eating or drinking?
Have you been taking sedative-hypnotic medication, such as zolpidem, before sleep?
Do you have a history of sleepwalking or night terrors as a child?
During an episode, are you fully aware of your surroundings and able to respond appropriately to another person?
Do you remember the episode clearly the next morning?
Do the episodes involve intense fear, confusion, or a feeling that someone is present?
Do you see or hear things that are not really there during an episode?
Are the movements and behaviors nearly identical each time?
Do the episodes begin suddenly and end abruptly, usually lasting less than two minutes?
Have you ever had similar spells while awake?
Do the episodes usually begin with you sitting up in bed?
During an episode, do you engage in complex, apparently purposeful movements such as handling objects or adjusting the bedding?
Do the episodes tend to occur after sleep deprivation, emotional stress, or an irregular sleep schedule?
Do you have excessive daytime sleepiness or irresistible urges to fall asleep during the day?
Have you ever experienced sleep paralysis or vivid hallucinations as you fall asleep or wake up?
Do you have a current or past psychiatric disorder, or a history of significant psychological trauma?
Are you taking antidepressants, stimulants, antipsychotics, or recreational drugs?
During the episodes, do you repeatedly rock your body or rhythmically move your pelvis against the bed?
Do you make repetitive rubbing or thrusting movements with your body or hands?
Are your eyes open during the episode?
Do you vocalize, such as moaning, grunting, or making repetitive sounds?
Does the episode usually last more than 10 minutes?
Have bedclothes or underwear sometimes been displaced or removed afterward?
Have witnesses ever observed sexual-appearing behavior during an episode?
